placements.why: The organization establishes recurring recovery verification and operational readiness as a structured domain.
placements.title: Operational resilience verified through scheduled rehearsal

placements.why: Quinton Fairweather establishes mandatory monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals with single-point ownership, asserting that an unrehearsed rollback is not a real capability.
placements.title: Rollback readiness exists only through verified rehearsal
placements.frame: How does the organization guarantee recovery capabilities through regular rehearsal cadences and explicit ownership?
